temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough and that she keeps thinking something more could have been done; Shirley says it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley cared for the patient and might be affected by the death, but she did not yet know how deeply Shirley was grieving or whether Shirley felt responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Shirley's somber demeanor and words confirm that she is deeply affected by the loss and is struggling with regret/self-doubt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is grieving deeply, may be carrying regret about the patient's death, and needs comfort and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to comfort Shirley, reassure her that they did what they could, and help her remember the good care they provided.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During coffee break, Sara raises treatment decisions; Shirley explicitly says she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different approach might have changed the outcome. Shirley appreciates Sara's reassurance but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and possibly feeling self-doubt or responsibility for the patient's outcome, but had not yet had it clearly confirmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Shirley directly confirms she feels responsible and is second-guessing treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is burdened by guilt/responsibility, struggles to accept reassurance, and needs ongoing support to avoid carrying the burden alone.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: empathy, concern, desire to relieve Shirley's guilt
temporal_state_chain.intention: to alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility, share the burden, and continue supportive conversation.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes that Shirley has remained reserved and minimally expressive. When confronted, Shirley admits she holds back feelings because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak; she says she will try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and felt responsible, and suspected Shirley was suppressing her emotions rather than expressing them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Shirley's response confirms she is holding back feelings due to fears of seeming unprofessional or weak, and she may be willing to open up with support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is emotionally guarded because of professionalism/strength concerns but is receptive to encouragement; expressing feelings among friends may help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to help Shirley feel safe expressing emotions, affirm that vulnerability is not weakness, and support her in being more open.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology. Shirley says continued talking helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed her previous confrontation might have been too harsh or pushy and worried it could have strained their friendship, while still seeing Shirley as needing support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Shirley confirms the confrontation felt like a bit much but was not malicious, accepts the apology, and values continued conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes the friendship can be mended and remains important to Shirley; she should be gentler and continue offering support through conversation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to apologize, mend the friendship, be more sensitive, and remain available for Shirley.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved. Shirley says she is feeling better because of their talks and Sara's support, and she agrees to spend time together outside work on the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still recovering and needed continued support, though she may have been unsure how much Shirley had improved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Shirley's improved demeanor and explicit statement confirm she is doing better and that Sara's talks/support have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is recovering with support, their relationship is a positive source of help, and spending more time together may further support Shirley's well-being.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to continue supporting Shirley, spend more time together outside work, and plan a weekend activity.
